title: Zephyr: DIS encode/decode
notes: Implemented strict Zephyr DIS full-message codec: complete TLV framing validation, singleton RFC 6550 Section 6.7.9 Solicited Information option with exact 19-byte payload, typed atomic parse/write APIs, duplicate/malformed rejection, preserved receive semantics for unused flags, and alias-safe all-or-nothing output. Corrected the canonical shared vector from invalid length 18/missing Version to length 19 with DODAGVersionNumber 66 and extended the host vector bridge. Gates: host C rpl_messages CTest 1/1; Python DIS 21/21; Python shared RPL vector tests 42/42; Rust filtered DIS/shared-vector tests 19 relevant passed plus all invoked filtered harnesses green; local Zephyr 4.1 nRF52840 messages.c.obj compiled with SDK 0.16.8. Pinned v3.7 tree unavailable locally per AGENTS.
